final_grader.about: Every run on the R8 build or later, graded again offline from its own exports by the final grader. Runs through T03R3 were regraded at 9b076a2 and the later grader changes (8cbd122, 8c24072, 41d79a2) move none of them; the R11 and T03R4 runs (build 5fe025c) were regraded at 689ab3b. A judge row keeps its recorded votes when the final grader sends the judge the same prompt; otherwise it is re-judged once (3 samples) with the final prompt. Only grader changes can move a score: world and colleague fixes can't change what a recorded run did. losses says whose the points a run still loses are: fair (the agent's), env (a world or colleague defect fixed since), or mixed.
